title: Mods, what they do, what I did
subtitle: Info and also books for them if there is one
description: This page is a collection of the mods that add meaningful content
It is here for you to see what mods the pack includes, and what might interest you!
The quests for the mods will give you books or hints on how to start them if applicable
And this quests reward gives you a book that you can craft with any other mod books to combine them all into one book! (The akahsic tome)
